plan.melodySummary: The tune opens in the warm, veiled low register of the Clarinet over a hushed Double Bass pad, then rises into the bright Piccolo as inner voices thicken and the dynamics swell in waves. The Trombone seizes the melody at the two-thirds climax with octave doublings and a soaring Piccolo countermelody above, before the Clarinet returns to resolve the round back to a gentle !p!.

sections.label: Phrase A — Emergence
sections.notes: Sing the melody legato and long-breathed at !p!, emerging from stillness; Trombone sustains a soft pad and Double Bass drones beneath, both kept under the melody.

sections.label: Phrase B — First Lift
sections.notes: Take the tune up into the light at !mp! with a gentle swell; the Clarinet weaves a quiet countermelody below while Trombone and Bass hold the pad, all voices staying beneath the Piccolo.

sections.label: Phrase C — Climax
sections.notes: This is the arrival: play the melody broad and !ff! with octave-strong tone, the peak of the whole arc; Piccolo soars ABOVE with a bright countermelody, Clarinet fills harmony, Double Bass reinforces the low arrival — the Trombone must dominate the texture.

sections.label: Phrase D — Resolution
sections.notes: Ease the dynamic back from !mf! to a final !p!, letting the round settle home; Piccolo adds a soft high halo and Trombone/Bass fade to a quiet sustained pad, all kept softer than the melody as it resolves.

Piccolo.instruction: Bright, airy top voice: carry the melody in Phrase B at !mp!, then soar as a high countermelody above the climax and provide a soft halo in the resolution — always float, never shrill.

Clarinet.instruction: Warm, expressive lead at the opening !p! and closing !p!; between, drop to a low countermelody and inner harmony, phrasing everything long and legato.

Trombone.instruction: Sustained low pad through most of the piece, then rise to a broad !ff! statement of the melody at the two-thirds climax with octave weight, reinforcing the arrival before receding to a soft pad.

Double Bass.instruction: Underpin every section with a sustained low pad and drone, swelling to reinforce the climax arrival in mm.17-24 and fading to !p! at the close; always support, never cover the melody.
